set.body: Secondary conditional-sensitivity court using the already frozen, cross-fitted GW-11 trial scores. Test whether full 0-3000 ms recognition gaze information varies with saliency and response correctness after adjusting for old/lure probe type, then localize descriptively to probe and delay. Use crossed participant/item effects, predeclared singular-fit fallback and bootstrap diagnostics. This post-primary analysis cannot rescue the failed GW-11 persistence verdict, select a default engine, or close GW-10. Keep participant-level inputs and outputs local-only and Git-ignored.
set.title: GW-12 Test recognition sensitivity to saliency and correctness
